svg.title: MFA: check what is on, register, sign in
svg.desc: Column 1: as an admin you look at the Microsoft Entra admin center. Azure already requires MFA with no opt-out, security defaults are only looked at, and per-user MFA stays Disabled. Column 2: the test user opens the Security info page in a private window, adds a method and scans a QR code in Microsoft Authenticator on a phone. Column 3: the test user signs in to the Azure portal with a password and approves the prompt, and the sign-in log then shows an Authenticator step.
svg.text: Sign-in log shows an Authenticator step
